## 1. Executive Summary & Engineering Scope
ADI Communications is an established British telecommunications, electronic security, and network infrastructure firm founded by Gary Pearce. We specialise in high-integrity physical installations, diagnostic fault-finding, and emergency hardware repairs:
- 100% Solid Oxygen-Free Bare Copper (Strict ban on brittle, voltage-dropping Copper-Clad Aluminium / CCA).
- Non-Destructive Structural Rigging (Non-drill stainless chimney lashing cradles with zero holes drilled into historic masonry).
- True 4K Surveillance with 24/7 Local Hardwired Storage (Western Digital Purple / Seagate SkyHawk drives, zero monthly subscriptions).
- Enterprise Wi-Fi Backbones through Thick Yorkshire Stone Walls (Dedicated Cat6/Cat6a hardwired backhauls).
- Grade 2 Wireless Security (Ajax Jeweller 868MHz encrypted frequency-hopping with sub-second jamming alarms).

## 4. Structured Cabling & Transmission Standards
### Cat6 U/UTP External PE
- **Conductor**: 23AWG Solid Bare Oxygen-Free Copper (100% Copper)
- **Bandwidth**: 250 MHz (1Gbps up to 100m, 10Gbps up to 37m)
- **Application**: Exterior building runs, Starlink drops, outdoor PoE CCTV cameras, waterproof drip loops.
- **Trade Warning**: Strictly zero Copper-Clad Aluminium (CCA) used.

### Cat6a S/FTP LSZH
- **Conductor**: 23AWG Solid Bare Copper
- **Bandwidth**: 500 MHz (True 10Gbps at full 100m channel)
- **Application**: High-density data centres, commercial backbones, ultra-fast AV video over IP.

### Cat5e U/UTP Internal
- **Conductor**: 24AWG Solid Bare Copper
- **Bandwidth**: 100 MHz (1Gbps up to 100m)
- **Application**: Basic domestic data drops, IP intercom links, legacy network replacements.

### Cat7 S/FTP High-Performance Shielded
- **Conductor**: 23AWG Solid Pure Copper
- **Bandwidth**: 600 MHz (10Gbps with heavy industrial noise immunity)
- **Application**: Factory and heavy machinery environment data drops.

### Cat8 S/FTP 40Gbps High-Speed
- **Conductor**: 22AWG/23AWG Solid Bare Copper
- **Bandwidth**: 2000 MHz (25Gbps / 40Gbps up to 30m)
- **Application**: Server-to-switch and SAN storage data links.

### Webro WF100 Digital Coaxial
- **Conductor**: 1.00mm Pure Annealed Plain Copper
- **Bandwidth**: N/A
- **Application**: Freeview digital TV drops, multi-room distribution, Freesat/Sky Q LNB runs.

### Webro WF65 Twin Shotgun Coax
- **Conductor**: 0.65mm Pure Solid Copper (Twin)
- **Bandwidth**: N/A
- **Application**: Compact twin-feed runs for satellite PVR receivers (Sky Q / Freesat twin tuner).

### OS2 9/125μm Single-Mode Optical Fibre
- **Conductor**: N/A
- **Bandwidth**: N/A
- **Application**: Long-distance campus links (>300m), zero electrical surge risk between farm outbuildings.

### OM4 50/125μm Multi-Mode Optical Fibre
- **Conductor**: N/A
- **Bandwidth**: N/A
- **Application**: Short-reach 10G/40G/100G intra-building backbone trunks.

## 5. Structural Mounting Systems & Masonry Anchors
### Non-Drill Chimney Lashing Cradle System
- **Purpose**: Secures Starlink dishes, aerial masts, and wireless bridges to brick chimneys with zero masonry drilling.
- **Key Hardware**: Galvanised steel lashing cradle, Stainless steel 5-strand wire, J-bolts & tension ratchets, Corner protection brackets
- **Wind Rating**: Engineered for 90mph gale resistance without brick spalling or mortar blowout.

### Heavy-Duty Welded Galvanised T&K Wall Brackets
- **Purpose**: Provides 18-inch to 24-inch standoff clearance from gable walls over deep roof overhangs and gutters.
- **Key Hardware**: Welded hot-dipped galvanised T-bracket and K-bracket, M10 high-tensile shield anchors, Double U-bolts for 2" alloy mast
- **Wind Rating**: Zero mast micro-flex during high-wind winter storms.

### CoreFix 100/120 Heavy-Duty Dot & Dab Drywall System
- **Purpose**: Spans the 10mm–30mm plasterboard void to anchor 65"–100" TVs directly into the blockwork behind.
- **Key Hardware**: 100mm/120mm high-tensile steel screw, Machined steel load-bearing collar sleeve, Heavy-duty nylon wall plug
- **Safe Working Load**: 100kg safe shear load per pair (never crushes plasterboard inward).

### SnapToggle Heavy-Duty Metal & Timber Stud Mounting
- **Purpose**: Locks heavy cantilever dual-arm TV brackets onto hollow drywall stud partitions where no solid masonry exists.
- **Key Hardware**: Solid zinc-plated steel pivoting channel, Nylon ratcheting guide leg, 1/4"-20 machine screws
- **Safe Working Load**: Up to 120kg ultimate shear load per anchor.

### Heavy-Duty Telescopic Ceiling Drop Mount
- **Purpose**: Suspends commercial displays or bedroom screens from high structural joists or concrete ceilings.
- **Key Hardware**: Telescopic heavy-gauge steel pole, Integrated internal cable routing channel, Swivel ceiling baseplate

## 6. Diagnostic Failure Matrix (Customer Pain-Points & Physical Solutions)
### Problem: CCTV Night-Time Vision is White Fog or Washed Out Glare
- **Root Cause**: Infrared reflection bouncing back off dome glass covers, nearby soffit boards, brick corners, or spiderweb buildup.
- **Certified Trade Solution**: Replace reflective glass dome with open-lens Turret (Eyeball) camera with separated dual IR/white-light emitters and ColorVu technology.

### Problem: CCTV Cameras Disconnect or Reboot Every Evening at Dusk
- **Root Cause**: Cheap Copper-Clad Aluminium (CCA) cable drops too much voltage under high electrical load when infrared LEDs activate at sunset.
- **Certified Trade Solution**: Replace substandard CCA with 100% solid oxygen-free copper Cat6 cable with IEEE 802.3at PoE+ power budget.

### Problem: Wi-Fi Drops Completely Inside 500mm Thick Stone Walls or Extensions
- **Root Cause**: High-density Yorkshire gritstone and foil-backed insulation absorb 5GHz and 6GHz wireless signals completely.
- **Certified Trade Solution**: Install hardwired solid copper Cat6 backhaul cables to discreet ceiling-mounted Wi-Fi 6/7 access points in every zone.

### Problem: Starlink Internet Stalls or Drops Satellite Lock in High Winds
- **Root Cause**: Flimsy aluminium poles or cheap swan-neck brackets flex 2–3 degrees in wind gusts, losing phased-array beam alignment.
- **Certified Trade Solution**: Mount on heavy-duty non-drill chimney lashing cradles or 18" welded T&K brackets with 2" heavy-gauge mast.

### Problem: Freeview TV Channels Pixelating, Freezing or Missing Completely
- **Root Cause**: 700MHz 5G or 800MHz 4G mobile phone mast transmission breaking into wideband unshielded TV aerial coax.
- **Certified Trade Solution**: Install CAI-benchmarked 5G LTE channel 48 low-pass filter, double-screened Webro WF100 coax, and spectrum analyzer realignment.

### Problem: DIY 433MHz Wireless Alarms Vulnerable to Cheap RF Jamming
- **Root Cause**: Single-frequency 433MHz wireless devices can be blinded by basic handheld transmitters without triggering an alarm.
- **Certified Trade Solution**: Upgrade to Grade 2 Ajax Jeweller 868MHz encrypted rolling-code frequency-hopping system with sub-second jamming detection.

### Problem: Fear of 75"–85" Heavy OLED TV Pulling Down Plasterboard Drywall
- **Root Cause**: Standard plastic drywall plugs pull straight out of gypsum board under dynamic cantilever forward weight.
- **Certified Trade Solution**: Professional structural mounting with CoreFix 120 (into solid block) or SnapToggle (into timber/metal studs) rated to 100kg+.
